group_recommendations.rationale: All of these tools, across the main cloudflare server, the agents-sdk server, the blog server, and the docs server, do nothing more than search or fetch static, public documentation or blog content by query/slug/tag. None reaches a live account resource or a caller-chosen live web target, so they share a single low-risk read-only profile despite living on different servers.

These are pure status/identity lookups -- who the session is authenticated as, the result of an already-started crawl job, and the list of active sessions -- with no navigation, mutation, or external side effect, matching the pure read/inspect exception called out for browser-surface tools.

Each tool drives a live remote browser to navigate to and render a caller-supplied arbitrary URL before extracting content (HTML, JSON, links, Markdown, PDF, screenshot, snapshot, or CSS-selector scrape). The caller chooses the target, which bypasses any allowlist by construction, so this cluster must not be merged into a read-only documentation group even though the data returned is non-mutating.

This tool combines the caller-chosen-target navigation risk of the browser surface with persistent, autonomous multi-page execution (depth/limit up to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, runs asynchronously after the call returns), warranting a higher risk tier than the single-page render tools.

Both tools mutate the state of existing browser-surface infrastructure (stopping a crawl job, terminating a session) by ID rather than navigating to new caller-chosen content; they are account-mutating but bounded to a targeted resource, distinct from both the pure-read status tools and the navigate-to-arbitrary-URL tools.

This tool runs arbitrary caller-authored JavaScript with unconstrained GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE access to the entire Cloudflare REST API for the account, explicitly flagged destructive and open-world by upstream. It is the single highest-risk tool among all five servers and must stand in its own group, never merged with any read-only or bounded-mutation cluster.

tools.description:
Search the Cloudflare documentation.

		This tool should be used to answer any question about Cloudflare products or features, including:
		- Workers, Pages, R2, Images, Stream, D1, Durable Objects, KV, Workflows, Hyperdrive, Queues
		- AI Search, Workers AI, Vectorize, AI Gateway, Browser Rendering
		- Zero Trust, Access, Tunnel, Gateway, Browser Isolation, WARP, DDOS, Magic Transit, Magic WAN
		- CDN, Cache, DNS, Zaraz, Argo, Rulesets, Terraform, Account and Billing

		Results are returned as semantically similar chunks to the query.
tools.name: cloudflare__docs
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream sets readOnlyHint to false, but the description and input schema describe a pure semantic-search query against static Cloudflare documentation with no path to create, update, or delete any resource, so the asserted hint appears to be an unset default rather than an accurate capability signal. The tool only accepts a free-text query and returns matching documentation chunks.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID to run against. Optional when the session is authorized for exactly one account, and for account-independent calls such as GET /accounts.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to execute

truncate.description: Cap the result at ~6,000 tokens. Set to false only when the result goes straight to a file or pipe, not into the conversation: without the cap, a broad query can return megabytes.

tools.name: cloudflare__execute
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream explicitly sets destructiveHint and openWorldHint to true, and the description confirms the tool runs arbitrary caller-authored JavaScript against the full Cloudflare REST API with GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE access scoped to any discoverable endpoint for the account. There is no allowlist on which endpoints or HTTP methods the code may call, making this an unconstrained, account-wide read/write/delete surface. Classified review-required (not merely high) to match the house convention for generic code-execution dispatchers against a real external account (same disposition as framer__exec).

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to search the OpenAPI spec

truncate.description: Cap the result at ~6,000 tokens. Set to false only when the result goes straight to a file or pipe, not into the conversation: without the cap, a broad query can return megabytes.

tools.name: cloudflare__search
tools.risk_rationale: Although readOnlyHint is false, the description and examples show the tool only runs sandboxed JavaScript over a static, pre-resolved OpenAPI specification object (`spec.paths`) to locate endpoint documentation -- it never calls cloudflare.request() or reaches a live account resource, so its effective capability is a documentation search.

tools.description: Return the Cloudflare user or account that this connection is authenticated as. Takes no arguments. The id is stable across token refresh, reconnection and permission changes.
tools.name: cloudflare__whoami
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream advertises readOnlyHint=true and destructiveHint=false; the tool takes no arguments and only returns the identity of the already-authenticated connection (id, name, email), exposing no mutation or external side effect.

tools.description: Token efficient search of the Cloudflare Agents SDK documentation

query.description: query string to search for eg. 'agent hibernate', 'schedule tasks'

tools.name: cloudflare-agents-sdk__search-agent-docs
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream publishes no annotation hints (empty object), but the description and schema show a bounded documentation search over the static Cloudflare Agents SDK docs, taking only a query string and a result-count limit, with no account or resource access of any kind.

tools.description:
Get a single Cloudflare Blog post by slug, including its full HTML content.

Use the slug from a list_posts or search_posts result.
tools.name: cloudflare-blog__get_post
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream advertises readOnlyHint=true, and the description and schema confirm a lookup of a single public blog post by slug, returning static published content with no mutation path.

tools.description:

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list_posts response

tools.description:

tools.risk_rationale: Upstream advertises readOnlyHint=true; the tool takes no arguments and only enumerates static taxonomy labels used on the public blog, with no mutation path.

tools.description:
Search the Cloudflare Blog using semantic search.

Use this tool to find blog posts about any Cloudflare topic, product, or technology.
Returns the most relevant posts with excerpts and URLs.

Examples of good queries:
- "Workers KV storage limits"
- "DDoS protection announcements 2024"
- "how Cloudflare uses Rust"
